(WebFetch extraction of The Times of Israel liveblog, 20 November 2026, retrieved ~08:40 GMT; times are Israel time)

8:41 am — Iranian FM mocks Israeli envoy as 'commander in chief of US military'. Israeli Ambassador Yechiel Leiter: "You get American soldiers back here to the United States to their families when Iran is defeated." Araghchi wrote on X: "We did not know that the Israeli Ambassador to Washington was the Commander-in-Chief of the U.S. Military."
9:43 am — Iraqi forces set to deploy today in stronghold of Iran-backed Kataeb Hezbollah: "Iraqi security forces will deploy in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataeb Hezbollah armed group, today". "Kataeb Hezbollah is the terror group responsible for kidnapping Israeli researcher Elizabeth Tsurkov".
9:08 am — Ukraine says drones hit 40 Russian oil, military targets in last 50 days.
10:17 am — Myanmar says ICJ conviction of genocide was not unanimous and is 'not fair'.
Sidebar headline: "Trump has repeatedly backed out of planned strikes — report".
